content: Aarooney Godaas Shiishshida Yarsho
Osppunththa gallassan Musey Aaroone, iza attuma naytanne Isra7eele asaa kaaleththiza cimata xeygides;
Aaroonekka, «Issi wosoykka istta bolla baynda issi mirgonne issi dharsho ekkada mirgoza nagara gishshas yarshiza yarsho dharshoza xuugettiza yarsho histta GODAAS yarsha.
Hessafe guye Isra7eele nayta nagara gishshas shiiqiza yarshos deysha orgenne istta bolla aykko wosoy baynda issi layththa mararanne issi layththa dorsa laaqqa xuugettiza yarshos ehana mala yoota.

Qasseka issi kormanne issi dorsa laaqqa issifeteththa yarshos ehetto; heytantta zayten gindettida kaththa yarshora GODAAS yarsho shiishshetto; hessa ubbaa ooththetto; gaasoykka Xoossi isttas hach qonccana» gides.
Isttika Musey istta azazidayssa ubbaa Dunkaaneza penge ehida; asay wurikka GODAA sinththan shiiqi eqqides.
Musey isttas, «GODAA bonchchoy inttes qonccana mala intte ooththanaas GODAY inttena azazida azazoy hayssa» gides.

Qasseka Musey Aaroones, «Gede yarshoy yarshettizaso shiiqada ne nagaranne dereza nagara wursanaas shiiqiza yarshonne xuugettiza yarsho yarsha; hessa ubbaa GODAY dereza nagara wursana mala izi nena azazida mala shiishsha» gides.
Aarooneykka yarsho yarshizaso biidi koyro ba nagaraa gishshas shiiqiza yarshos shiiqiza mirgoza shukkides.
Iza nayti suuththaa izas ehida; izikka suuththaan ba biradhdhe gelththi kessidi yarsho yarshizasoza bolla diza dhemota suuth tiydes; attida suuththaa yarsho yarshizaso garsan gussides.
Hessafe kaaleththidi moodheza, kilahotanne tire kammi oykkida moodheta ekkidi GODAY Muse azazida mala yarsho yarshizasoza bolla xuuggides.
Ashozanne galbaza qasse asay dizasoppe gede haraso haassidi xuuggides.
Hessafe guye Aarooney xuugettiza yarshos shukkides; histtiin iza nayti suuththaa izas ehida; izikka suuththaza ekkidi yarsho yarshizasoza bolla yuuyi aadhdhanaas wuxxides.
Iza nayti xuugettiza yarshos shukettida ashoza qommon qommon hu7ezara gaththi izas ehi immida; izikka hessa ubbaa yarsho yarshizasoza bolla xuuggides.
Hessafe qasseka qanththa ashozanne guye tohota haaththan meeccidi yarsho yarshizasoza bolla xuugettiza yarshozara issife gaththi xuugettizason xuuggides.
Hessafe kaaleththidi Aarooney dereza nagaraa gishshas shukettiza deysha orge ekki shukkidi ba nagara gishshas yarshidayssaththo yarshides.
Xuugettiza yarshoza ehidi kase diza wogaa mala yarshides.
Kaththa yarshozakka shiishshides; dhiillezappe kuphpha kumeth ekkidi yarsho yarshizasoza bolla xuuggides; hessika xuugettiza yarshos maalado maalado shiiqiza yarshoza bolla gujettidi shiiqides.
Korma booraanne dharshoza shukkidi dereza gishshas issifeteththa yarsho shiishshides; iza naytikka suuththaa izas ehida; izikka suuththaa ekkidi yarsho yarshizasoza yuuyi aadhdhanaas wuxxides.

Aarooneykka korma booraa moodheza, dharshaa moodheza, ubbaaka goyna tolthoza, qanththa asho kammi oykkida moodhezanne tire kammi oykkida moodheza doorettidayssa tiretanne istta bolla diza moodheza ekkidi,
he meheta angaso xeera bolla woththida; Aarooney moodheza ubbaaka yarsho yarshizasoza bolla xuuggides.
Angasotanne ushachcha geda ashota Musey azazida mala yaanne haa qaaseththidi GODAAS dumma yarsho histti shiishshides.
Aarooney nagara gishshas shiiqiza yarsho, xuugettiza yarshonne issifeteththa gishshas shiiqiza yarsho yarshidaappe guye ba kushe dhoqqu histtidi deraa anjjidi wodhdhides.
Museynne Aarooney Gaytoteththa Dunkaane giddo gelida; heeppe kezishe dereza anjjida; GODAA bonchchoy asa ubbaas qonccides.
Asay qoppontta dishin GODAA achchafe kiitettida tamay yiidi yarsho yarshizasoza bolla diza yarshos shiiqida handaza ubbaa mides; derezikka wuri hessa be7idi ilili gidessinne wurikka hokki goynnides.
